props.name: className
props.comment: A class name to apply to the icon.

props.name: defaultValue
props.comment: The value shown when the one at `source` is `undefined`.

props.name: empty
props.comment:
The text shown when the value is empty. Translated through `i18n` when one
is given, printed as is otherwise. With none, the field renders nothing.

props.name: FalseIcon
props.comment: The icon for a false value. `null` for none. Default `X`.

props.name: looseValue
props.comment: Treat any truthy value, not only `true`, as true. Default false.

props.name: record
props.comment: The record to read. Required: there is no record context to fall back on.

props.name: source
props.comment: Name of the property to display (dot/bracket path).

props.name: TrueIcon
props.comment: The icon for a true value. `null` for none. Default `Check`.

props.name: valueLabelFalse
props.comment: The label for a false value, a translation key or text. Default `chelone.boolean.false`.

props.name: valueLabelTrue
props.comment: The label for a true value, a translation key or text. Default `chelone.boolean.true`.
